verdict.rationale: Warp's first-party session restoration docs say it automatically restores windows, tabs, panes and recent Blocks when you relaunch, so you can pick up where you left off. That covers the core of the story. The docs do not explicitly say working directories are restored or that restoration works after a crash rather than a normal relaunch, and nothing independent confirms it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of working-directory restoration, explicit crash-recovery behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can restore my windows, tabs, and working directories after a restart or crash

citations.quote: Restore your windows, tabs, panes, and recent Blocks automatically when you relaunch Warp.
Session restoration allows you to quickly pick up where you left off in your previous terminal session.
